verdict.rationale: Rive's docs are served in agent-friendly markdown (docs/*.md return 200) and explicitly point agents to a documentation index at https://rive.app/docs/llms.txt for full-site context, satisfying the 'point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs' story even though the conventional root-level /llms.txt path 404s. Missing for 10: direct confirmation that /docs/llms.txt itself loads and contains a complete index, and no independent (non-vendor) corroboration of an agent successfully using it.
